exports.description: How the data table shows. `'hidden'`: visually hidden, read by assistive technology (no visible chrome). `'details'`: a native `<details>` disclosure under the plot, so anyone can open the values (zero JS).

exports.description: How x labels line up with the plot. `'point'`: one label per point of a point scale (lines and areas): the first sits at the plot's start edge, the last at its end edge, both clamped inward. `'band'`: one label centred in each band of a band scale (bars).

exports.description: Whether the caption shows. `'visible'`: the title and summary above the plot. `'hidden'`: both visually hidden (clipped to a 1 × 1 box out of flow, never `display: none`), for a chart whose container already titles it (a card header, as on a revenue card): the caption takes no layout space, stays in the HTML and still names the figure and its data table.
exports.name: ChartTitleVisibility

exports.description: The direction of the x axis. Time and value axes do not mirror by default (§14.1, §16.4). `'rtl'` mirrors the plot and its x labels; `'auto'` mirrors them when the page's `dir` is right-to-left (HTML directionality, CSS `:dir(rtl)`), in the server HTML already, and the ChartInteraction island reads the resolved direction after hydration.
exports.name: ChartXDirection
